decision.summary: All engineering acceptance criteria satisfied across promotion production locks, atomic first-store welcome entitlement serialization, checkout production lock guards, and canonical ledger subsidy posting. P0-01 (promotion lock policy test expectations), P0-02 (atomic R50 customer row locking & single internalCode enforcement), P0-03 (production test approval veto), and canonical browser order creation (namespaced order/adjustment ledger source reference formatting) are resolved and verified. Local suites pass cleanly with 0 TypeScript errors, 0 ESLint errors, valid Prisma schema, 113 safe incremental migrations, 417 payment tests passing, 115 refund tests passing, 23 BOLA security tests passing, 63 processor tests passing, 226 policy tests passing, and 145 parcel tests passing. Commercial release remains strictly NO-GO pending authentic human owner, legal, and banking signoff.

P0_01_promotionProductionLockPolicyAsser.resolution: Updated test assertions across all 3 policy suites to assert that promotions fail closed with PromotionsProductionLockedError in production even when { approved: true } is supplied. Added table-driven test verifying all 15 money-changing promotion operations reject production bypasses, while explicitly verifying that test approvals are permitted only in verified test-scoped environments ({ NODE_ENV: 'test', PAYSTACK_MODE: 'test' }).
P0_01_promotionProductionLockPolicyAsser.testEvidence: npx vitest run tests/policy/ (45 files, 226/226 tests passed)

P0_02_atomicFirstStoreWelcomeEntitlement.resolution: Eliminated silent try/catch block around SELECT ... FOR UPDATE customer row lock. Introduced typed WelcomeEligibilityLockUnavailableError (code WELCOME_ELIGIBILITY_LOCK_UNAVAILABLE) that fails closed when customer locks cannot be acquired. Added optional lockAdapter injection in dependencies for unit tests while enforcing strict serializable database locking in production. Removed permissive name fallback query, enforcing strict single internalCode: 'FIRST_STORE_WELCOME'.

P0_03_marketplaceCheckoutProductionLockG.resolution: Guarded assertMarketplaceCheckoutProductionReady against testApproval bypass in live production by checking isActualProductionInstance(source). Throws MarketplaceCheckoutProductionLockedError with code PRODUCTION_TEST_APPROVAL_FORBIDDEN when testApproval is passed under NODE_ENV=production, PAYSTACK_MODE=live, or with live secret keys.

CANONICAL_BROWSER_ledgerSourceReferenceN.resolution: Updated postPlatformSubsidyJournalInTx and reversePlatformSubsidyJournalInTx to pass namespaced sourceReference strings ('order:<ref>' and 'adjustment:<ref>') conforming strictly to the /^[A-Z0-9_-]+:[A-Z0-9_:-]+$/ format required by normalizeLedgerPosting. Aligned e2e fixtures to set establishedSignupDate on non-promotional test customers.

invariantsPreserved: No feature branches or rebase operations; all work strictly additive on main working copy.
Zero destructive database migrations; historical ledger entries and order snapshots remain immutable.
PostgreSQL check constraints MarketplaceCheckout_payment_split and MarketplaceCheckout_totals_check strictly enforced.
Promotions production lock (PROMOTIONS_PRODUCTION_VALIDATION_APPROVED = false) truthfully preserved.
Fail-closed commercial release veto maintained; live financial trading prohibited without authorized signature.
